name: Chanel No. 5
notes: aldehydes, ylang-ylang, neroli, jasmine, iris, rose, sandalwood, vetiver, civet, oakmoss
description: The iconic floral aldehyde classic. Timeless, powdery, and deeply feminine with a bouquet of flowers wrapped in warm woods.

name: Sauvage
notes: bergamot, pepper, lavender, pink pepper, vetiver, patchouli, geranium, elemi, ambroxan
description: A wild, raw, and rugged masculine scent. Radiant bergamot and pepper on a woody ambrosia base.

name: Bleu de Chanel
notes: citrus, ginger, nutmeg, jasmine, iso e super, labdanum, sandalwood, patchouli, incense, vetiver
description: A sophisticated woody aromatic for men. Clean citrus opens to a warm, deep woody heart.

name: Black Orchid
notes: black truffle, ylang-ylang, blackcurrant, black orchid, dark chocolate, patchouli, vanilla, sandalwood
description: Dark and seductive with black flowers, rich earth, and decadent chocolate. Mysterious and opulent.

name: Acqua di Gio
notes: calabrian bergamot, neroli, green tangerine, jasmine, rosemary, marine accord, patchouli, white musk
description: The quintessential aquatic fragrance. Mediterranean sea breeze with citrus and marine freshness.

name: La Vie Est Belle
notes: blackcurrant, pear, iris, jasmine, orange blossom, praline, vanilla, patchouli, musk
description: A joyful and feminine fragrance. Sweet praline and iris with a warm vanilla base.

name: Miss Dior
notes: blood orange, strawberry, rose, iris, patchouli, musk
description: Fresh and romantic with sparkling citrus and delicate rose petals on a modern chypre base.

name: Flowerbomb
notes: bergamot, tea, freesia, jasmine, rose, orchid, patchouli, musk
description: An explosion of flowers. Lush and intoxicating floral bouquet with a warm, sweet musk finish.

name: J'adore
notes: Damascus plum, magnolia, champaca flower, jasmine, tuberose, rose, musk, blackberry
description: Ultra-feminine and luminous. A cascade of white flowers with juicy fruit on a sensual musk.

name: Coco Mademoiselle
notes: orange, bergamot, grapefruit, rose, jasmine, iris, mimosa, patchouli, vetiver, musk
description: Bold yet feminine. Sparkling citrus with a heart of rose and jasmine on an earthy patchouli base.

name: Oud Wood
notes: oud, rosewood, cardamom, sandalwood, vetiver, amber, tonka bean
description: Rare, luxurious oud softened by sandalwood and cardamom. Warm, smoky, and deeply exotic.

name: Light Blue
notes: Sicilian cedar, apple, bellflower, white rose, bamboo, jasmine, white rose, musk, cedarwood
description: Carefree Sicilian summer in a bottle. Crisp apple and cedar with a clean floral heart.

name: Aventus
notes: pineapple, bergamot, black currant, apple, birch, patchouli, musk, oakmoss, ambergris
description: The king of masculine fragrances. Bold pineapple and blackcurrant over smoky birch and mossy base.

name: Shalimar
notes: bergamot, lemon, jasmine, rose, iris, vetiver, opoponax, tonka bean, civet, musk
description: The original oriental fragrance. Citrus-kissed flowers melt into a rich vanilla and incense drydown.

name: Angel
notes: red fruits, blackcurrant, honey, jasmine, caramel, chocolate, patchouli, vanilla
description: The original gourmand fragrance. Sweet caramel and chocolate with a dark patchouli heart.

name: Terre d'Hermes
notes: grapefruit, orange, flint, pepper, pelargonium, vetiver, benzoin, cedar
description: Mineral and earthy with radiant citrus. A journey from sky to earth, light to darkness.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540
notes: jasmine, saffron, amberwood, fir resin, cedar
description: An airy, luminous amber fragrance. Warm sweetness with a radiant woody-floral character.

name: Tobacco Vanille
notes: tobacco leaf, vanilla, tonka bean, tobacco flower, wood sap, cocoa, dried fruit
description: Rich and comforting tobacco sweetened by vanilla and dried fruits. Like a cozy evening by the fire.

name: Molecule 01
notes: iso e super
description: A single molecule fragrance. Iso E Super alone — cedar-like, woody, skin-like, unique on everyone.

name: Neroli Portofino
notes: neroli, bergamot, lemon, mandarin orange, lavender, jasmine, myrtle, rosemary, amber, musk
description: Italian Riviera bottled. Sparkling neroli and citrus with a clean floral heart and warm amber finish.

name: Silver Mountain Water
notes: bergamot, mandarin orange, green tea, blackcurrant, sandalwood, musk
description: Like cold, pure mountain stream water. Green tea and blackcurrant with a clean metallic mineral quality.

name: Eros
notes: mint, green apple, lemon, tonka bean, geranium, ambroxan, vanilla, vetiver, oakmoss
description: Bold and passionate. Fresh mint and apple over warm tonka bean and sensual amber wood.

name: Good Girl
notes: almond, coffee, tonka bean, tuberose, jasmine, cocoa, virginia cedar, sandalwood, musk
description: Duality of good and bad. Sweet almond and coffee with a full floral heart and woody base.

name: Si
notes: blackcurrant nectar, freesia, rose, patchouli, vanilla, ambrewood
description: Sensual and modern femininity. Blackcurrant sparkle over delicate florals and warm patchouli.

name: Libre
notes: lavender, mandarin orange, jasmine, orange blossom, musk, ambergris, cedarmoss, vanilla
description: A declaration of freedom. Lavender and orange blossom clash beautifully over a warm musk base.

name: Y
notes: bergamot, ginger, geranium, sage, fir balsam, cedar, amberwood
description: Energetic and modern masculine. Fresh bergamot and sage with a bold woody aromatic heart.

name: Versace Pour Homme
notes: lemon, bergamot, neroli, jasmine, Mediterranean sea notes, hyacinth, cedar, musk
description: Mediterranean freshness. Citrus and sea breeze with a hyacinth heart and clean woody base.

name: 1 Million
notes: mandarin orange, blood orange, grapefruit, cinnamon, rose, spices, leather, patchouli, blond wood
description: Gold-bar seduction. Sweet spices and leather with bright citrus and a dark, sensual drydown.

name: La Nuit de l'Homme
notes: cardamom, bergamot, lavender, cedar, coumarin, vetiver
description: Night-time sensuality. Spicy cardamom and lavender meld into a warm, smooth cedar and coumarin base.

name: Daisy
notes: strawberry, violet leaves, blood grapefruit, gardenia, jasmine, violet petals, musk, vanilla, white woods
description: Fresh and innocent. Strawberry and grapefruit with a heart of gardenia and a clean white musk finish.

name: Clean Reserve Warm Cotton
notes: bergamot, lavender, cyclamen, orris, sandalwood, musk
description: The purest comfort scent. Fresh laundry and clean skin — warm cotton and soft musk.

name: Bal d'Afrique
notes: bergamot, African marigold, violet, vetiver, jasmine, cyclamen, musk, cedarwood, Moroccan cedarwood
description: African marigold and bergamot with rich vetiver and musk. A vibrant floral with an earthy grounding.

name: Rose 31
notes: rose, cumin, cedar, gaiac wood, labdanum, musk, oud
description: A masculine take on rose. Spiced cumin and earthy woods give rose a dark, complex character.

name: Santal 33
notes: cardamom, iris, violet, sandalwood, papyrus, cedarwood, leather, musk
description: Cult status sandalwood. Warm cardamom and violet over creamy sandalwood and leather. Instantly recognizable.

name: Nishane Hacivat
notes: pineapple, bergamot, jasmine, patchouli, sandalwood, musk
description: Hacivat balances tropical pineapple with fresh bergamot and a rich, earthy patchouli-sandalwood base.

name: Spicebomb
notes: bergamot, grapefruit, cinnamon, chili pepper, tobacco, vetiver, leather
description: An explosive blend of spices. Tobacco and leather ignite with chili and cinnamon for a fiery masculine scent.

name: Invictus
notes: grapefruit, sea salt, jasmine, bay laurel, guaiac wood, oakmoss, ambergris
description: Victory in a bottle. Sea salt and grapefruit with a warm woody amber base. Sporty and confident.

name: Tresor
notes: peach, apricot, rose, jasmine, iris, heliotrope, sandalwood, musk, vanilla
description: A timeless romantic fragrance. Soft peach and iris with rose and a warm, powdery vanilla base.

name: Opium
notes: bergamot, pepper, plum, jasmine, rose, carnation, mandarin, cinnamon, clove, patchouli, frankincense
description: Rich and intoxicating oriental. A dazzling mosaic of flowers and spices on a deep, smoky base.

name: N°19
notes: neroli, aldehydes, iris, rose, lily of the valley, nerol, vetiver, oakmoss, sandalwood
description: Sophisticated green floral. Crisp aldehydes and iris with a clean, earthy vetiver and oakmoss base.

name: Midnight in Paris
notes: rum, cardamom, mimosa, mango, amber, violet, leather, tonka bean, patchouli, musk
description: The essence of Parisian nights. Rum and spice with rich floral and leather notes. Mysterious and elegant.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia
notes: calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon, Sicilian orange, lavender, verbena, rosemary, sandalwood, vetiver
description: Italian elegance distilled. Pure Mediterranean citrus over classic barbershop herbs and warm sandalwood.

name: Calone
notes: sea water, bergamot, lavender, calone, jasmine, neroli, sandalwood, musk, cedar
description: The original men's aquatic. Ocean freshness with aromatic herbs and clean woody notes.

name: Obsession
notes: mandarin orange, bergamot, lemon, jasmine, orange blossom, sandalwood, cedarwood, vetiver, amber, musk
description: Sensual and daring. A warm oriental with citrus top, floral heart, and deep amber and sandalwood base.

name: Eternity
notes: freesia, sage, marigold, violet, lily, jasmine, sandalwood, amber, musk
description: Timeless and clean. Fresh florals and green herbs with a soft warm musk. Enduringly romantic.

name: Fahrenheit
notes: bergamot, lavender, hawthorn, jasmine, nutmeg, violet, sandalwood, cedar, leather, vetiver
description: Iconic and polarizing. Petrol leather accord with violet and nutmeg. Warm, smoky, and utterly unique.

name: Burberry Weekend
notes: lemon, mandarin orange, peach, cedar, sandalwood, musk
description: Light and breezy outdoors. Fresh citrus and peach with clean woods. Perfect warm-weather companion.

name: Givenchy Gentleman
notes: bergamot, iris, patchouli, vetiver, leather, tobacco
description: A modern gentleman accord. Powdery iris and tobacco over a dark leather and patchouli base.

name: Chrome
notes: pineapple, bergamot, lemon, rosemary, jasmine, lily of the valley, coriander, sandalwood, oakmoss, musk
description: Sporty and versatile. Crisp citrus and pineapple with aromatic herbs and a clean woody musk finish.

name: Wanted
notes: lemon, cardamom, juniper, vetiver, guaiac wood, suede
description: Magnetic and charismatic. Zesty lemon and cardamom with warm guaiac wood and suede. Modern Western spirit.
